description: Testing an Umbraco package's C# code on Umbraco's own integration test package (Umbraco.Cms.Tests.Integration): what the test project must add before any database test runs, getting `UmbracoTestServerTestBase` to serve the package's controllers, and switching caching and cache refreshers back on, so a test exercises the package instead of passing by default. Use when adding a C# test project, or writing or reviewing a test on `UmbracoIntegrationTest`, `UmbracoTestServerTestBase` or `ManagementApiTest<T>`, especially one that checks cached data or a Management API endpoint.
